images.author: Hasmik Ghazaryan Olson
images.why: Blue-washed medina alley; the photographer explicitly identifies Chefchaouen, Morocco. Strong colour and architectural focus; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Marcel L.
images.why: Vivid blue stepped alley with contrasting green plants and inviting depth. Small hotel sign is present; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Matt Dany
images.why: Photographer-described panorama of Chefchaouen, offering a town overview alternative to the blue lanes. Original dimensions and tight-crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Nikola Kojević
images.why: Elevated view of Dubrovnik Old Town, its historic walls and terracotta roofs beside the Adriatic. Strong subject match; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Kristijan Arsov
images.why: Bird's-eye view of the Old Town port, combining historic architecture, harbour walls and water. Original dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Yena Kwon
images.why: Gyeonghoeru pavilion reflected in its pond, with traditional red columns, greenery and blue sky. Source confirms Gyeongbokgung Palace; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: speedwagwon
images.why: Explicitly identified Geunjeongjeon throne hall against blue sky. Verified 2835 × 3780; portrait alternative with visitors present.

images.author: Junway
images.why: Recognisable St. Paul's stone façade against clear blue sky; source location explicitly names 大三巴牌坊. Tighter architectural view; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Werapinthorn Jaijan
images.why: Real film photograph explicitly depicting St. Paul's ruins, with emphasis on the stone façade. Staircase coverage, sky colour and original dimensions unverified.

images.author: 2H Media
images.why: Desert view with blue sky; photographer confirms all three Giza pyramids are visible. Preserve the outer pyramids when cropping; original dimensions unverified.

images.author: Dmitrii Zhodzishskii
images.why: Desert composition explicitly identifying Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure together. Strong landmark match; warm-light quality, original dimensions and tight-crop suitability unverified.
